title: Frontmatter Metrics
description: Schema for the 'frontmatter' key inside the unified review-output metrics object.

value.description: FM-1: count of top-level type declarations with no solid-frontmatter block immediately above them

additional-info.description: Optional list of type names missing frontmatter: [string]

value.description: FM-2: count of frontmatter blocks whose solid-name does not match the declared type name
FM-3: count of frontmatter blocks whose solid-category is blank or not a recognizable domain role
FM-4: count of frontmatter blocks whose solid-stack lists an unused framework or omits one clearly depended on

additional-info.description: Optional list of violations: [{type_name, extra: [...], missing: [...]}]

value.description: FM-5: count of frontmatter blocks whose solid-description is vague, implementation-level, or missing the required Contract-for prefix for abstractions
